newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Q3 GDP rises 7.4 percent year-on-year.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Q3 GDP rises 7.4 percent year-on-year.

text.p: Mexico's third quarter Gross Domestic Product rose by 7.4 percent compared to the third quarter of last year, the Finance Ministry said on Thursday.
The figure was better than forecast by a Reuters survey of 11 brokerages, banks and research firms in Mexico City which had predicted third quarter GDP of 6.47 percent.

The ministry said in a statement this was the second consecutive quarter of year-on-year GDP growth. GDP for the first nine months of the year has grown 4.4 percent compared to the same period of 1995, it added.
The industrial sector was the engine of growth during the quarter, growing by 14.6 percent overall, the ministry said.
Construction grew 24.9 percent, manufacturing rose 13.9 percent, mining grew 5.7 percent, and gas, electricity and water generation increased 5.6 percent.
The service sector as a whole grew 5.4 percent. The ministry did not give growth figures for the agricultural sector.
